messages:
mika_design: uploaded a compact-vectors mock — aim: denser preview for power users, inline relevance, and quick export CTA. figma: https://figma.redwood/example/compact-download

owen_research: love the density. request: show vector length (norm) as a small column, helps quick filtering.

leah_a11y: a11y points: treat as a grid (role=\"grid\"), add sr-only label for the chevron 'Expand details', ensure `aria-expanded` on rows and visible focus ring.

jamal_frontend: implementation notes: use semantic grid roles, keyboard shortcuts (Space toggles selection, Shift+click range), and a persistent kebab menu that appears on focus. avoid hover-only controls on touch.

ben_prod: export behavior: small sets download immediately, large sets should queue. propose threshold 500 rows. modal copy: \"Download vectors (CSV)\" + estimated size and opt-in checkbox \"Run in background and notify me\".

mika_design: copy tweak: use 'Download' for immediate case and 'Queue download' for background. show a small live status: 'Export started' for screen readers.

aria_bot: a11y-scan: flagged items 1 1: relevance chip contrast failing (3.0:1), chevron missing sr-only label, export status missing aria-live.

jamal_frontend: will add aria-live region role=\"status\" for export feedback, implement long-press for mobile menu, and keep 44px hit targets. virtualization required when >200 rows.

leah_a11y: also add color+icon on relevance chips for colorblind users, and `aria-pressed` on pin toggle.

mika_design: ok i'll update figma with: vector_norm column, visible chevron + sr copy, darker relevance chip + icon, persistent action bar when rows selected, and revised export modal copy. new mock: https://figma.redwood/example/compact-download-v2

owen_research: small UX ask: ephemeral toast after rerank 'Reranked 1 item' and update tiny sparkline; announce via aria-live.

ben_prod: i'll set export queue threshold and background worker behavior in the ticket. will prioritize estimated size in modal.

mika_design: thanks — please react with :eyes: if you want to test keyboard nav during sprint 42.
